## Fixture section

This synthetic note exercises the production content pipeline.

```typescript
const fixture = 'isolated';
```

A second block with lines of growing length, so the copy button is checked against real text.

```text
alpha line number 01 of the ladder
bravo line number 02 of the ladder here
charlie line number 03 of the ladder here ok
delta line number 04 of the ladder here and more
echo line number 05 of the ladder here and some more
foxtrot line number 06 of the ladder here and even more text
```

And one with a title, which moves the button below the tab bar.

```text title="ladder.txt"
alpha line number 01 of the ladder
bravo line number 02 of the ladder here
charlie line number 03 of the ladder here ok
delta line number 04 of the ladder here and more
```

See the [reference page](https://example.org/reference) for details; the [next note](/notes/smoke-es-next/) stays in this tab.
